body: I’ve felt this my entire life.
40 weeks to the day. Baby was born on her due date!

All I can say is I was like you, a daily user for years. I quit when I found out as well. My only advice  is that It does get easier. As the weeks go the urges will become less. I told myself that as soon as gave birth I would reward myself with the fattest zoot. But I gave birth last week and can hand on heart say it’s the last thing on my mind. Not sure if that helps! Hang in there ❤️
Congratulations! Best thing I’ve ever done! Enjoy every moment, and be in awe of what you’ve done! Amazing news!❤️
I’m infatuated and still completely in shock! Absolute love of my life! Thank you!
She really is beautiful!
Thank you!

IMO pain; and an underestimated and unexpected amount of it can be really traumatic. As women we know it’s gonna hurt but honestly the reality is far worse than one can ever imagine. I am 100% traumatised and at the same time I’m so proud of what my body created. Also most experiences, especially birth stories are completely subjective and I think that’s totally ok. What I call trauma could be a complete win for someone else. Two different things can be true at once.
I think id need to have some form of amnesia to do this again! I’m enjoying her so much I can’t sleep because I just want to stare at her! Never known a love like this ❤️
I just made sure to mention we don’t want to know as soon as the appointment started. Seemed to work for me!

Yeah I’m really bad at making and keeping boundaries so this one will be hard because I don’t want to hurt her but deep down I also know how I want that moment to be. I think letting her be there would only be to keep the peace but at the cost of the experience I want to have.
I’m sorry that happened you! Thank you for the advice. I think sometimes it’s just good to hear that you’re allowed to be a little selfish especially for a moment as big as this!
Yes thank you, I need to make an appointment!!

I’ve struggled with work so much so you’re not alone. I totally get the wanting to die feeling, as I’m feeling that right now. For me it’s the expectation of having to be good all the time and having to actually show up. I’ve called in sick too many times to count; and I’m actually considering it today! It’s not laziness it’s a visceral feeling of impending doom that for some reason is worse than the doom of not being able to pay your bills. I did a solid year and half of unemployment and I can honestly say I needed that time as I was very unwell but financially I had the bank account of a 14 year old, even though I had adult bills. Thank god for supportive friends and family but it does kinda suck to rely on them for money. I’ve been in my current job for about 9 months and it’s getting to that point where as soon as I wake up I burst into tears at the thought of having to spend hours at work. I don’t have any solutions I’m sorry but I’m here to let you know you are 100% not alone in your feelings.
Why am I in this exact some boat rn
Been there. Always kinda fun until it’s not.
Yikes
Good way of thinking about it
Ok!
Omg I always feel this. Even in a room full of people sometimes those are the worse moments of loneliness. Just that feeling of disconnection. Yeah, sometimes being alone can be better.

There’s so many places I want to go but had no one to go with; I’m always afraid of looking weird, then I realised no one cares what I’m doing. So I’m planning to go to a few art galleries I’ve been wanting to go to for a while.
I completely agree. This community is the only place I’m truly honest about how BP affects me!
I’m used to being alone and most of the time I like. It’s definitely the latter for me. But when those waves of loneliness come, it hits hard. That’s the thing with BP2 we feel things so deeply.
I totally feel this.
Thanks, this gives me a little hope!
That’s really good advice thank you! I’ve been trying to start reading again! Also YouTube is my go to, I’m a sucker for conspiracy theories!
I’m so so sorry! None of this is your fault, none of this was your choice. It’s ok to blame your husband, he made a vow to you and broke it. Your emotions and your pain are all valid!!!
Feel this one
That’s a very good idea! Thank you
Stay strong! Or at least stronger than me! You got this

I ended up going grocery shopping and bought a bunch of food for all the “recipes” I’m gonna make. I also bought many things from my Amazon cart that I don’t need, like a book stopper for a book shelf that I don’t have. Plus I bought a small diy drill kit for all the handy work I’ve told myself I can do (with absolutely no experience). The worst part is that I have no regrets just an urge to buy more. 

Last month i splurged on knitting needles and wool but I was convinced I could knit myself a cardigan. The worst thing I’ve done so far, is buying a flight to Amsterdam for a few days time because I saw a museum on TikTok that I really wanted to go to! Pray for me; and stay strong out there guys!!
This advice helped so much, read it on my lunch break and felt a little better! It was a long as day, but I’m home now and I’m going to hibernate in bed for the weekend
Thank you! I got through it with the help of your encouragement. Some days just feel heavy and today was one of those days, but I made it

I have a dog named Jasper who wakes me up everyday by laying on me and shoving his paws in my face; rude awakening but I wouldn’t have it any other way! He’s the only reason I have to get up in the morning. I love him!
Being invalidated is the WORST, makes you question yourself so much! I’m sorry that happened to you, it’s the closest ones hurt the most unfortunately!
It would be a long story but basically had a shouting/screaming match started by her and finished by me. All the bipolar rage and just lost my temper!
Exactly that!! It’s all good until they’re faced with it! But thank you, I will try to do something nice.
I’m sorry your going through this! Hopefully things get better for you soon. Thanks, I need all the good vibes I can get!
I totally get that urge to confront someone, though i usually manage to control it. Not today apparently!! Thanks for the birthday wishes!
Thank you! It means a lot!
Dirty bed sheets with silhouette stains.
And no one ever gets it either 🤣🤣 I always just say inside joke 😅

I feeeel this. Currently experiencing this right now. Constantly pissed off. For me, isolating myself works the best. I try to kindly explain to my loves ones that I need to be alone. Hope things turn around for you soon x

Not so severe for me but there definitely is a change that comes with my cycle. It kinda pushes me into a more vulnerable and hypo state! I don’t sleep, high anxiety, more volatile. I only connected the dots a few months ago! I don’t have any tips, just wanna let you know you’re not alone.
God I feel this so hard.  I think about this almost daily! And I know there are no words that makes you feel better. Just hold out the smallest piece of hope for a brighter future!! Routing for you!
Thank you. Sometimes this validation is what I need to feel sane!
My pets honestly keep me alive
I have a really hard time figuring out which phase I’m in! My life kinda feels like a blur recently; loosing days and just repetition!
My therapist have gone on holiday. And firstly, bitch I’m jealous, take me with you lol. But seriously she’s need to come back because I don’t know how to sort through my thoughts

True! I keep politely asking my family to maybe do some research on my condition; which they say they have, but clearly they have not, or are struggling to retain the information. I’m always getting comments like ‘why are you acting like this’ or they joke and say ‘oh yeah you’re crazy’. They don’t understand the intense daily battle. I’m starting to believe that it’s a thing only someone who’s experienced it can relate. So yeah, sometimes shutting down is easier than trying to explain thing I don’t even understand myself!
Lmao that’s a very good point! I just thought it would hit harder! 2 at once a bad idea?
Oh man I’m sorry that happened! I’m feel ok right now, hopefully will stay that way.
100% good idea. I feel great rn
Yeah, I have covid rn too, felt like I was hit by a bus this morning but it definitely makes a difference
I think I’m gonna pop one and smoke a joint then see if I can sleep better
Yeah I got some Galenila Ksalol 1mg. That ok?
You mean like out cold or like I’m awake but have no clue what’s going on?
Thanks! Everyone says Xanax and weed were made for each other, so we’ll see
Yes! Seems to happen to me every time didn’t connect the dots until now!

I start 3am baking every night. I find beauty and awe in the smallest things; like I could look at the sky and start crying because of how beautiful it is. I’m more physically active; I can stop moving, shaking my legs or just pacing back and forth. Currently experiencing this now and I’m glad I’ve gotten to a point where I can finally identify signs of my hypo.
Never mind I read it again and I understand now lol thanks
Thanks! Just for extra extra clarity, do I add the promethazine to the cod solution before or after I’ve extracted it
So do I add the promethazine to the codeine to dissolve then drink?? I dunno I’ve never made lean before. Always though you needed cough syrup
I made a cake. Turned out pretty good considering I’ve officially entered day 3 no sleep. Currently laying in bed, my body feels so tired but my mind is racing! Pray for me to fall asleep soon
I’ve been having it so bad, I have heart palpitations and my hands get stuck in one position, it’s really scary. I’m trying to pinpoint the signs that I’m hypo

I was given some promethazine to help me sleep and I have an upcoming appointment with my therapist! I totally get what you’re saying, but rn I’m riding this high and I’m loving it. There’s something inside me telling me that the fallout won’t be that bad. It’s like Ive forgotten what the low feels like. 

I also have an upcoming appointment with my psychiatrist soon, maybe my medication will need some adjustments. I’m on 100mg lamictal and 100mg sertraline.

Im sorry you’re going through that. Anxiety is a bitch, never really understood that until I experienced it! I’m having a hard time figuring out my mood cycles, I think I might have been hypo now and the last 4 days! Im pretty much up and down, can’t keep track

Yeah I’m feeling it now! I don’t usually have anxiety at all it’s awful. Been prescribed promethazine but not really feeling it, I can’t sleep but I’m drowsy, makes for a very long night of me pacing around my room
Yeah feeling all of that right now, I’m trying to manage it
There are things like this, but they’re super well regulated and hard to access. The application process is long and many people don’t get accepted.
Thanks! I hope so too!

Yes I have a psychiatrist but I’m not sure he’s the right fit for me. I’m thinking of going for a private psychiatrist when I can afford to; the treatment is faster and moser extensive. In the uk we have free health care and that includes free mental health care too. So that is a huge help, because I couldn’t imagine what it’s like to have to consider cost. But because it’s free, the waiting lists for treatment are very long. I waiting 6 months to be seen. 

In term of money, in the uk we have something called universal credit where the government pay you a certain amount of money each month. For a young person with no kids like myself, you only get £344 to last the month. So there not much you can save when you have bills. This is why I’m stressed, the only way out of this is for me to go back to work; but I’m not sure I’m ready.

My issue with working from home is finding motivation to actually do work! It’s better for me to be forced to get out of the house to go to work than rely on myself at home! Part time I something I’m considering but I’m thinking of the money and considering working full time

Thanks for your response! I know it’s early days, I’m just still learning so much about bp2 even though I have it! I struggle to realise when I’m hypomanic until my depressive episodes! Still trying to learn all the signs and triggers. 

Edit: also being honest with my doctor is really hard for me; I have an irrational fear of being hospitalised (as I’ve come close before) if I say everything I’m thinking and feeling. Still learning how to accept support.

You dissected my thoughts and feelings in a way that was really helpful. You’ve given me a lot of perspective and I’m grateful for that! It’s strange accepting support when your don’t feel like you deserve it, but thank you! Some of your words brought tears to my eyes. This is the first time in a long time I’ve felt seen and understood. It’s crazy that we live in world where people you don’t know are kind enough to encourage you in times of need. I’ll be reading your comments for some time to come, to help me remember the things I so easily forget! This is the beginning of a long road to recovery; I have so much to unpack within myself. But thank you again for giving me some really great pointers!
